snippet.title: Alt+F4 - Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description: Check out the Reveal Trailer for Alt+F4, a puzzle adventure game developed by Skeleton Corp. Players will explore a labyrinth where every “Exit the Game?” confirmation window is no longer a way out, but a movement system. Pressing Yes or No moves you up, down, left, or right. Find gold, pay a debt, or get a rematch in Alt+F4, coming soon to PC (Steam).
